{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|As you know, it is time once again for the forest to give us the thing we hold dearest to our hearts! The precious wood&hellip;|[[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]]|<ref name="E3">[[Ewoks (1985) 3|''Ewoks'' (1985) 3]]</ref>}}
'''Sacred wood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] that was both strong and light. The [[Tree/Legends|trees]] from which the wood could be taken grew in an area of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] where the forest gave way to [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Its properties made the material useful to [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] for the construction of [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin gliders]].<ref name="E3" />

The Ewoks of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] harvested the wood for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Council of Elders]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] chose a group of three villagers to fell some of the wood with an [[annointed stone blade]] during the annual [[Harvest Ceremony]]. The Ewok who flew back to the village with the wood received the added honor of performing hang gliding tricks during the ceremony.<ref name="E3" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] undertook the journey to gather sacred wood for Bright Tree. However, when they arrived, they found that [[Primate/Legends|simian]] beings known as [[Quork/Legends|Quorks]] had already cut down the wood. The Quorks captured the Ewoks and demanded they construct a glider for them, but the Ewoks managed to escape with the sacred wood in tow.<ref name="E3" />
